cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC(C)(C)C(=O)O[C@@H](c1ccccc1)c1ccc2ccccc2c1'))
nhc=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[C]1N(c2c(C)cc(C)cc2C)CCN1c1c(C)cc(C)cc1C'))
print('chiral',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(lig), 'atoms',lig.GetNumAtoms(),nhc.GetNumAtoms(),flush=True)
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3();ps.randomSeed=7070;ps.numThreads=0;ps.pruneRmsThresh=0.35
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(lig,numConfs=35,params=ps)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(lig,numThreads=0,maxIters=500)
AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(nhc,numConfs=8,params=ps)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(nhc,numThreads=0,maxIters=1000)
prop=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(lig)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(lig,prop,confId=0)
N=lig.GetNumAtoms()
ring=np.arange(14,24)
# functions for coordinate terms

def distpen(x,g,i,j,d,k):
    v=x[i]-x[j];r=np.linalg.norm(v);diff=r-d
    t=2*k*diff/(r+1e-16)*v;g[i]+=t;g[j]-=t
    return k*diff*diff

def lowdist(x,g,i,j,d,k):
    v=x[i]-x[j];r=np.linalg.norm(v)
    if r>=d:return 0.
    diff=r-d;t=2*k*diff/(r+1e-16)*v;g[i]+=t;g[j]-=t
    return k*diff*diff

candidates=[]
for ci in ids:
    xx=np.array(lig.GetConformer(int(ci)).GetPositions())
    origin=(xx[14]+xx[23])/2
    vx=xx[14]-xx[23];vx/=np.linalg.norm(vx)
    vy=xx[17]-origin;vy-=np.dot(vy,vx)*vx;vy/=np.linalg.norm(vy)
    vz=np.cross(vx,vy)
    xx=(xx-origin)@np.stack([vx,vy,vz],axis=1)
    for side in [1,-1]:
        ni=np.array([0.,0.,side*1.82])
        coords=np.vstack([xx,ni]);target=xx[ring].copy()
        def energy(v):
            x=v.reshape(-1,3);q=x[:N].ravel().tolist()
            e=ff.CalcEnergy(q);g=np.zeros_like(x);g[:N]=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(q)).reshape(-1,3)
            e+=distpen(x,g,5,N,2.00,100.)
            e+=distpen(x,g,4,N,2.97,35.)
            e+=distpen(x,g,14,N,1.98,80.)
            e+=distpen(x,g,23,N,1.98,80.)
            # keep aromatic almost in original pose and Ni about reference position
            d=x[ring]-target;e+=30*np.sum(d*d);g[ring]+=60*d
            d=x[N]-ni;e+=15*np.dot(d,d);g[N]+=30*d
            for i in range(N):
                if i in [5,14,23]:continue
                mind=2.65 if lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()!='H' else 2.15
                e+=lowdist(x,g,i,N,mind,20.)
            return e,g.ravel()
        opt=minimize(energy,coords.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':450,'ftol':1e-8})
        candidates.append((opt.fun,opt.x.reshape(-1,3),side,int(ci)))
candidates.sort(key=lambda p:p[0]);print('ligand candidates',[(round(p[0],1),p[2],p[3]) for p in candidates[:10]],flush=True)
np.savez('lig_stage.npz',coords=np.array([p[1] for p in candidates[:10]]),energies=np.array([p[0] for p in candidates[:10]]))
Chem.MolToMolFile(lig,'lig.mol',confId=0)
Chem.MolToMolFile(nhc,'nhc.mol',confId=0)
# assemble a full organic forcefield for NHC and ligand, retaining good MMFF for ligand and UFF for NHC.
ffn=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(nhc,confId=0)
M=nhc.GetNumAtoms();NI=N+M
best=[]
# Interligand repulsion radius sums (low-dist harmonic only)
radii={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'H':1.20}
rL=np.array([radii[a.GetSymbol()] for a in lig.GetAtoms()]);rN=np.array([radii[a.GetSymbol()] for a in nhc.GetAtoms()])
# allow slightly less than vdW sums, as MMFF/UFF minima vdW mixed radii are softer
threshold=(rL[:,None]+rN[None,:])*0.90

def anglepen(x,g,a,b,c,cos0,k):
    u=x[a]-x[b];v=x[c]-x[b];ru=np.linalg.norm(u);rv=np.linalg.norm(v);uu=u/ru;vv=v/rv;co=np.dot(uu,vv);dd=co-cos0
    da=2*k*dd*(vv-co*uu)/ru;dc=2*k*dd*(uu-co*vv)/rv
    g[a]+=da;g[c]+=dc;g[b]-=da+dc
    return k*dd*dd

for ci,(e0,coords,side,lci) in enumerate(candidates[:6]):
    xlig=coords[:N];ni=coords[N]
    cen=(xlig[14]+xlig[23])/2
    v1=(xlig[5]-ni);v1/=np.linalg.norm(v1)
    v2=(cen-ni);v2/=np.linalg.norm(v2)
    axis=-(v1+v2);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
    # unit desired Ni->carbene direction
    plane=np.cross(v1,v2);plane/=np.linalg.norm(plane)
    ortho=np.cross(axis,plane)
    for nci in range(min(4,nhc.GetNumConformers())):
        xn=np.array(nhc.GetConformer(nci).GetPositions())
        nh0=xn[0].copy();u=(xn[1]+xn[13])/2-nh0;u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
        w=xn[1]-xn[13];w-=np.dot(w,u)*u;w/=np.linalg.norm(w)
        t=np.cross(u,w)
        local=(xn-nh0)@np.stack([u,w,t],axis=1)
        # several rotations around Ni-carbene axis
        for deg in [0,60,120,180]:
            theta=np.deg2rad(deg)
            wdest=np.cos(theta)*plane+np.sin(theta)*ortho
            tdest=np.cross(axis,wdest)
            xn=local@np.stack([axis,wdest,tdest])+ni+axis*1.90
            x0=np.vstack([xlig,xn,ni])
            target=xlig[ring].copy()
            def complexenergy(q):
                x=q.reshape(-1,3);pl=x[:N].ravel().tolist();pn=x[N:NI].ravel().tolist()
                e=ff.CalcEnergy(pl)+ffn.CalcEnergy(pn);g=np.zeros_like(x)
                g[:N]=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(pl)).reshape(-1,3);g[N:NI]=np.array(ffn.CalcGrad(pn)).reshape(-1,3)
                # two eta2 contacts, coordinated ester oxygen, carbene carbon
                e+=distpen(x,g,14,NI,2.03,140.)
                e+=distpen(x,g,23,NI,2.03,140.)
                e+=distpen(x,g,5,NI,2.04,150.)
                e+=distpen(x,g,4,NI,2.96,35.)
                e+=distpen(x,g,N,NI,1.90,180.)
                # nickel points along bisector away from carbene N atoms
                e+=anglepen(x,g,N+1,N,NI,np.cos(np.deg2rad(127.5)),70.)
                e+=anglepen(x,g,N+13,N,NI,np.cos(np.deg2rad(127.5)),70.)
                # essentially planar three ligand arrangement at Ni
                e+=anglepen(x,g,N,NI,5,np.cos(np.deg2rad(133)),65.)
                # arene midpoint virtual ligand gradients explicit
                v=x[N]-x[NI];w=(x[14]+x[23])/2-x[NI]
                rv=np.linalg.norm(v);rw=np.linalg.norm(w);uv=v/rv;uw=w/rw;cos=np.dot(uv,uw);delta=cos-np.cos(np.deg2rad(133))
                e+=65*delta*delta
                dv=130*delta*(uw-cos*uv)/rv;dw=130*delta*(uv-cos*uw)/rw
                g[N]+=dv;g[14]+=dw/2;g[23]+=dw/2;g[NI]-=dv+dw
                # keep laboratory-frame drift controlled with weak arene positional restraints
                d=x[ring]-target;e+=2*np.sum(d*d);g[ring]+=4*d
                # NHC carbene bonds corrected for partial double-bond character
                e+=distpen(x,g,N,N+1,1.36,200.)
                e+=distpen(x,g,N,N+13,1.36,200.)
                # interligand contact avoidance
                delta=x[:N,None,:]-x[None,N:NI,:]
                ds=np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=2);viol=np.minimum(ds-threshold,0)
                e+=15*np.sum(viol*viol)
                gf=30*viol[:,:,None]*delta/(ds[:,:,None]+1e-14)
                g[:N]+=gf.sum(axis=1);g[N:NI]-=gf.sum(axis=0)
                for i in range(NI):
                    if i in [5,14,23,N]:continue
                    # NHC neighbouring N are only 2.8 from Ni by design
                    sym=(lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol() if i<N else nhc.GetAtomWithIdx(i-N).GetSymbol())
                    mind=2.5 if sym!='H' else 2.05
                    e+=lowdist(x,g,i,NI,mind,20.)
                return e,g.ravel()
            opt=minimize(complexenergy,x0.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':800,'ftol':5e-9})
            best.append((opt.fun,opt.x.reshape(-1,3),ci,nci,deg))
        print('completed',ci,nci,'best',min(p[0] for p in best),flush=True)
np.savez('full_stage.npz',coords=np.array([p[1] for p in sorted(best,key=lambda p:p[0])[:10]]),energies=np.array([p[0] for p in sorted(best,key=lambda p:p[0])[:10]]))
best.sort(key=lambda p:p[0]);print('best',[(round(p[0],2),p[2:]) for p in best[:10]],flush=True)
x=best[0][1]
syms=[a.GetSymbol() for a in lig.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in nhc.GetAtoms()]+['Ni']
x-=x[-1]
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{len(syms)}\nNi(SIMes) eta2-naphthalene ester complex; S stereocenter; angstrom\n')
    for s,v in zip(syms,x):f.write(f'{s:2s} {v[0]: .8f} {v[1]: .8f} {v[2]: .8f}\n')
# chirality confirmation
conf=lig.GetConformer(0)
for i in range(N):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,x[i])
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(lig,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(lig,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('3D chiral assignment',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(lig),flush=True)
print('nickel contacts',[(i,syms[i],float(np.linalg.norm(x[i]))) for i in [5,14,23,N]])
